Issues found (4):

store.js:67 The debounced save writes to currentNote without checking it, and it saves whichever note is current when the timer fires. The user edits note A and, within 500ms, clicks note B or deletes A. The timer fires and copies the editor contents (now B's, or none) into the new currentNote, which overwrites B with A's edits. If A was deleted, currentNote is null and the timer throws a TypeError, and the edit is lost.

app.js:10 List is not re-rendered after a save, so titles and ranks go stale. The save timer in store.js updates the note but never calls renderList. Driven: renamed a note to 'Renamed'; the list still read 'Untitled' with rank #1. Rename the open note: the sidebar keeps the old title and the '#rank' badge (which depends on the updated time) is wrong until some other action re-renders.
On a fresh install with no notes, typing in #title or #body fires scheduleSave. 500 ms later the timeout runs currentNote.title = ... and throws TypeError: Cannot set properties of null.

Edited titles and rank badges don't refresh in the list. scheduleSave (store.js:15-20) updates the note and saves it but never calls renderList. The sidebar keeps the old title and rank until something else re-renders it.

app.js:32 Clicking a shared-note row throws: the row has no data-id. Shared rows are <li class="shared"> with no dataset (app.js:46), and the list click handler matches any li. Number(undefined) is NaN, notes.find returns undefined, and openNote then reads currentNote.title (app.js:18). Search for anything that returns a shared note and click it: Uncaught TypeError, and currentNote becomes undefined. The editor keeps the previous note's text, and the next edit throws in the save timer (store.js:16).
Typing with no note open throws an error and loses the text (store.js:16).

store.js:25 Each tab writes its whole in-memory array, so a second tab overwrites the first's notes. notes is read once at load (store.js:2) and persist() always writes the entire array. There is no 'storage' event listener and no re-read before writing. Open the app in tabs A and B. In B create and fill a note. In A, edit any existing note. A's save writes its stale array and the note created in B disappears from storage, permanently.

store.js:18 Saving never re-renders the list, so renamed titles and the '#rank' badge stay stale. Traced. scheduleSave updates title and updated and persists, but never calls renderList. The list is only rebuilt on open, delete, search or New. Rename the open note 'Untitled' to 'Groceries'. The sidebar still says 'Untitled' and the rank badge still shows the old rank until the user searches or switches notes. Search by the new title also uses stale rendering until the next render.
The 500 ms timer callback dereferences currentNote.title without a null check.
